name: Steal Lucky Blocks From Backrooms
desc:
Steal Lucky Blocks From Backrooms! 🧠
Run fast and collect the rarest Brainrots! ⚡ 
Build your massive tycoon base and survive the chaos! 🔥
Upgrade your Carry Limit and Speed to handle more loot! 🏗️ 
Unlock new floors and slots to display your collection! 🔒 
Dodge the incoming monsters to survive 🔥

Your Brainrots earn cash automatically! 💤 (Even while you sleep!)

💎 Premium Players get a free Brainrot

If you’re having fun, LIKE the game 👍 and tell your friends! 😄
